## Welcome! {.unlisted .unnumbered}

SWR Notes explores engineering electromagnetics, connecting physical intuition with mathematical analysis.
Here, we examine antennas, radiation, and RF from first principles asking how they work, why the equations take their form, and what connects seemingly different phenomena.
:::
:::

::: {.maxwell-section aria-label="Maxwell's equations in a homogeneous linear medium"}
$$
\begin{aligned}
\nabla\cdot\mathbf E &= \rho/\varepsilon,\\[0.7em]
\nabla\cdot\mathbf B &= 0,\\[0.7em]
\nabla\times\mathbf E &= -\frac{\partial\mathbf B}{\partial t},\\[0.7em]
\nabla\times\mathbf H &= \mathbf J+\frac{\partial\mathbf D}{\partial t}.
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
